hypotheses.H1: Matched-capacity joint 4D TBMD lowers property-wise anomaly-relative Frobenius reconstruction error versus independent 3D TBMD.
hypotheses.H2: Matched-capacity joint 4D TBMD raises property-wise anomaly mask-aware SSIM versus independent 3D TBMD.
hypotheses.H3: The paired 4D-minus-3D effect changes with sensor budget.
hypotheses.H4: The paired effect is larger when train-only pressure-saturation anomaly coupling is stronger.
hypotheses.H5: A 4D model may improve spatial structure even when physical-unit RMSE is worse.

outer_protocol.name: P2 leave-one-scenario-out
outer_protocol.outer_use: single evaluation after all fold-specific choices are frozen

inner_protocol.selection_loss: 0.5*mean(property anomaly-relative Frobenius)+0.5*mean(property DSSIM), where DSSIM=(1-anomaly SSIM)/2

headline_metrics.reconstruction: property-wise anomaly-relative Frobenius error in inverse-scaled physical fields, using the outer-training ensemble mean at each cell and timestamp
headline_metrics.structure: property-wise mask-aware local Gaussian SSIM of anomalies, using train-only anomaly range

ssim.aggregation: mean over valid active-centred windows, then timestamps, then fold

variants.3D-independent: separate space-space-time tensor factors and coefficients
variants.4D-A: joint property tensor with shared spatial factors and coefficients
variants.4D-B: shared spatial factors and separate property coefficients
variants.4D-D: shared spatial factors plus property-specific spatial residual factors
variants.4D-E: joint property modes plus independent property residual modes

representation_search.historical_comparator: E8 fixed (48,48,2) current joint 4D retained separately

well_geometry.placement: configured existing-well order shared by every method

grid_geometry.placement: common train-only QR-DG order from a rank-64 POD-E basis of standardized ensemble anomalies

sensing.noise: none in the primary E9 comparison

pre_outer_amendments.change: LASSO moved from the exhaustive inner Cartesian search to a frozen-final sensitivity analysis.
pre_outer_amendments.reason: The first interrupted train-only fold showed ADMM iteration cost dominated the study. No E9 outer result existed or was inspected; all LS/ridge candidates and all preregistered representations, metrics, folds, budgets, and decision rules are unchanged.

pre_outer_amendments.change: Recovery solver and regularisation are selected jointly for each matched 3D-4D pair, using the mean inner-validation loss of both methods.
pre_outer_amendments.reason: This enforces the preregistered identical-solver requirement literally. No E9 outer result existed or was inspected; the complete train-only solver registries permit deterministic reselection without rerunning or changing any candidate.

selection_and_reporting.method: select representation per method from inner folds, then select one common recovery solver and regularisation for each matched 3D-4D pair by their mean inner-validation loss, within capacity, geometry, and budget
selection_and_reporting.paired_unit: outer held-out scenario with identical rows and timestamps
selection_and_reporting.advantage_rule: A metric-specific empirical advantage requires a favourable median paired difference and a favourable result in at least 7 of 10 folds at matched coefficient and sensor budgets.
selection_and_reporting.central_claim_rule: A broad 4D claim additionally requires the advantage in both capacity regimes or at two adjacent sensor budgets, with storage reported and no outer-driven retuning.
selection_and_reporting.structural_only_rule: If only SSIM satisfies the rule, the claim is limited to structural fidelity and must disclose RMSE and reconstruction-error losses.
